coverageNote: A curated selection of releases and milestones. Dates retain the day, month or year established by their sources.

events.title: Nelson Mandela walks free
events.summary: Mandela leaves Victor Verster Prison after 27 years in prison.

events.title: Depeche Mode releases Violator
events.summary: Personal Jesus and Enjoy the Silence share a place on the same record.

events.title: Twin Peaks asks who killed Laura Palmer
events.summary: A murder mystery brings an unusually strange town to ABC.

events.title: Hubble leaves Earth
events.summary: Space shuttle Discovery lifts off with the Hubble Space Telescope aboard.

events.title: Windows 3.0 puts icons on the desktop
events.summary: Program Manager gives the PC a desktop full of things to click.

events.title: Total Recall takes a trip to Mars
events.summary: A summer cinema trip with a few questions about memory.

events.title: The Fresh Prince moves to Bel-Air
events.summary: Will Smith brings a rapper’s timing to a family sitcom.

events.title: Germany reunifies
events.summary: Celebrations at the Reichstag mark the end of Germany’s division.

events.title: F-Zero reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: A futuristic racing game turns the launch-era Super Famicom into a demonstration of speed, depth and an unusually exposed track.

events.title: Super Mario World introduces Yoshi
events.summary: Dinosaur Land gives Mario a new traveling companion.

events.title: Edward Scissorhands arrives for December
events.summary: A very unusual visitor joins the holiday-season cinema calendar.

events.title: The Bulls win their first NBA title
events.summary: Chicago beats the Lakers to finish the Finals.

events.title: Sonic races onto the Mega Drive and Genesis
events.summary: Sega’s blue hedgehog makes speed part of the console rivalry.

events.title: Terminator 2 returns for the summer
events.summary: The sequel opens during the July cinema season.

events.title: Ganbare Goemon: Yukihime Kyūshutsu Emaki reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: Goemon’s journey mixes an imagined historical Japan with conspicuously modern jokes and attractions.

events.title: The Web gets a public invitation
events.summary: Tim Berners-Lee posts about the WorldWideWeb project on Usenet.

events.title: Rugrats sees the world from the carpet
events.summary: Tommy Pickles and his friends join Nickelodeon’s first Nicktoons.

events.title: Metallica releases the Black Album
events.summary: Metallica’s self-titled album arrives on the band’s official release calendar.

events.title: Pearl Jam releases Ten
events.summary: Alive, Even Flow, and Jeremy arrive on the band’s debut album.

events.title: Nirvana releases Nevermind
events.summary: Nirvana releases Nevermind. The artist’s official discography supplies the release date.

events.title: Super Ghouls ’n Ghosts reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: Arthur’s fragile armor and demanding jumps make progress a matter of learning a level’s timing.

events.title: Beauty and the Beast opens in November
events.summary: A Disney animation joins the autumn theatrical calendar.

events.title: A Link to the Past opens two Hyrules
events.summary: Link’s Super Famicom adventure begins in Japan.

events.title: Super Formation Soccer reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: A view from behind the action gives a football match a different feel from a side-on sports game.

events.title: Wayne’s World goes to the movies
events.summary: The television sketch gets a cinema-sized outing.

events.title: Contra Spirits reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: Contra Spirits, known in North America as Contra III, alternates side-view action with overhead stages.

events.title: Windows 3.1 ships
events.summary: Microsoft ships the next major version of Windows.

events.title: Euro Disney opens outside Paris
events.summary: A new Disney resort brings a theme-park holiday closer to European visitors.

events.title: The Real World moves seven strangers in
events.summary: MTV turns a shared New York home into a television series.

events.title: Johnny Carson signs off from The Tonight Show
events.summary: A familiar late-night appointment ends after nearly thirty years.

events.title: Barcelona opens the Summer Olympics
events.summary: The opening ceremony starts a summer of televised competition.

events.title: Mall of America opens its doors
events.summary: Mall life goes supersized in Bloomington, Minnesota.

events.title: Super Mario Kart starts the race
events.summary: Mario’s cast trades platform jumps for karts and banana peels.

events.title: Aladdin joins the holiday movie season
events.summary: Disney’s animated adventure opens in November.

events.title: Whitney Houston leads The Bodyguard soundtrack
events.summary: The soundtrack arrives before the film’s US theatrical opening.

events.title: Nirvana releases Incesticide
events.summary: Nirvana releases Incesticide. The artist’s official discography supplies the release date.

events.title: Elvis becomes a stamp-sized collectible
events.summary: A 29-cent postage stamp puts a music icon on the envelope.

events.title: Monday Night Raw goes live
events.summary: Wrestling takes a weekly live slot from the Manhattan Center.

events.title: Groundhog Day starts repeating itself
events.summary: A February opening for a film about one very long day.

events.title: Star Fox reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: Polygonal spacecraft and landscapes make the Super Famicom experiment with a different visual vocabulary.

events.title: Pentium becomes the new PC name
events.summary: Intel introduces its first Pentium processors.

events.title: CERN opens its Web software
events.summary: CERN puts the core World Wide Web software into the public domain.

events.title: Jurassic Park opens the gates
events.summary: The dinosaurs arrive in time for the summer cinema season.

events.title: Secret of Mana / Seiken Densetsu 2 reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: An action role-playing adventure lets several characters occupy the journey together.

events.title: The X-Files pairs a believer with a skeptic
events.summary: Mulder and Scully start investigating the unexplained on Fox.

events.title: Nirvana releases In Utero
events.summary: Nirvana releases In Utero. The artist’s official discography supplies the release date.

events.title: Wu-Tang Clan enters the 36 Chambers
events.summary: Nine voices, soul samples, and martial-arts film references fill a debut album.

events.title: Endeavour heads out to repair Hubble
events.summary: Seven astronauts begin the telescope’s first servicing mission.

events.title: Doom escapes onto PCs
events.summary: A shareware episode makes a trip through the computer desk feel much less like homework.

events.title: Mega Man X / Rockman X reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: Rockman X introduces a new setting and expanded movement to a familiar action-game lineage.

events.title: Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: A campaign of positioned units asks the player to consider the cost of each move.

events.title: Green Day releases Dookie
events.summary: A short, loud record brings Bay Area punk to a major label.

events.title: Super Metroid reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: Samus returns to a world whose passages change meaning as her abilities grow.

events.title: Final Fantasy VI reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: An ensemble role-playing story places machinery and magic in the same world.

events.title: Nelson Mandela casts his first democratic vote
events.summary: Mandela votes in South Africa’s first democratic elections.

events.title: The Channel Tunnel officially opens
events.summary: The inauguration links Britain and France beneath the Channel.

events.title: Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: A console version of the expanded arcade fighter brings a larger character roster into the living room.

events.title: Forrest Gump opens in July
events.summary: A summer opening on the North American theatrical calendar.

events.title: Brazil wins the World Cup on penalties
events.summary: The final at the Rose Bowl reaches a shootout after a goalless match.

events.title: ER begins a busy night in Chicago
events.summary: The two-hour pilot sends NBC viewers into County General.

events.title: Friends opens the door to Central Perk
events.summary: Six friends join NBC’s Thursday-night lineup.

events.title: The Web gets a standards consortium
events.summary: W3C forms to coordinate a Web that can work across different systems.

events.title: Pulp Fiction reaches the autumn screen
events.summary: The October opening puts it in a different season from the summer blockbusters.

events.title: Donkey Kong Country / Super Donkey Kong reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: Rendered character art gives a cartridge-console platform game a new surface, while switching between Donkey and Diddy affects how a player moves through its hazards.

events.title: PlayStation launches in Japan
events.summary: Sony’s first PlayStation arrives in its home market.

events.title: Michael Jordan returns to the Bulls
events.summary: Jordan takes the court again against Indiana.

events.title: Java gets its public introduction
events.summary: A new programming language joins the growing conversation about the Web.

events.title: Alanis Morissette releases Jagged Little Pill
events.summary: You Oughta Know gives the album its sharpest introduction.

events.title: South Africa wins the Rugby World Cup
events.summary: Nelson Mandela joins the final wearing Francois Pienaar’s number six.

events.title: Apollo 13 reaches the summer screen
events.summary: A June theatrical opening for the spaceflight drama.

events.title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi’s Island reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: A drawn-paper look offers another answer to the decade’s search for graphical novelty.

events.title: Windows 95 introduces a new Start
events.summary: Windows 95 launches with the Start menu and taskbar.

events.title: AuctionWeb begins the eBay story
events.summary: An online marketplace starts small in San Jose.

events.title: PlayStation reaches North America
events.summary: PlayStation’s North American launch follows its Japanese debut.

events.title: Panel de Pon reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: Matching panels becomes a game of anticipating the next change rather than waiting for a single lucky arrangement.

events.title: Toy Story arrives for Thanksgiving week
events.summary: Woody and Buzz join the November cinema calendar.

events.title: Galileo arrives at Jupiter
events.summary: An orbiter and atmospheric probe reach their destination.

events.title: A tiny patch of sky becomes a Deep Field
events.summary: NASA releases the Hubble Deep Field, revealing galaxies in a seemingly sparse patch of sky.

events.title: Pokémon Red and Green begin the journey
events.summary: The original Pokémon games launch for Game Boy in Japan.

events.title: Super Mario RPG reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: Mario steps into a role-playing structure with an assembled party and turn-based encounters.

events.title: Kirby Super Star / Kirby’s Fun Pak reaches Super Famicom in Japan
events.summary: A set of different modes turns one cartridge into a small collection of Kirby adventures.

events.title: Metallica turns the page with Load
events.summary: Load opens a new chapter in Metallica’s album catalog.

events.title: Quake opens the Slipgate
events.summary: id Software’s Quake brings its 3D world to the PC.

events.title: Nintendo 64 arrives in Japan
events.summary: Nintendo’s new console makes its Japanese debut.

events.title: Hotmail puts an inbox in the browser
events.summary: Hotmail announces free web-based email, available from July 4, 1996. The original company announcement survives in the NET-HAPPENINGS mailing-list archive.

events.title: Dolly the sheep is born
events.summary: Dolly is born at the Roslin Institute in Scotland.

events.title: The Spice Girls introduce Wannabe
events.summary: The group’s first UK single makes friendship the hook.

events.title: Muhammad Ali lights the Atlanta cauldron
events.summary: The opening ceremony supplies the Summer Games with an unforgettable last torchbearer.

events.title: Nintendo 64 launches in the U.S.
events.summary: Nintendo 64 arrives with Super Mario 64 leading the way.

events.title: Fountains of Wayne releases its debut
events.summary: Fountains of Wayne arrives with compact guitar-pop songs on a self-titled debut.

events.title: Luther Vandross releases Your Secret Love
events.summary: Luther Vandross adds Your Secret Love to a career already associated with close attention to vocal phrasing.

events.title: Nirvana releases From the Muddy Banks of the Wishkah
events.summary: A live collection restores the volume and abrasion of Nirvana onstage after the quieter presentation of MTV Unplugged.

events.title: Phish releases Billy Breathes
events.summary: Billy Breathes concentrates a band known for open-ended live performance into the sequence of a studio album.

events.title: Westside Connection releases Bow Down
events.summary: Ice Cube, Mack 10 and WC bring distinct careers into Westside Connection.

events.title: AOL announces its $19.95 flat-rate plan
events.summary: AOL announces a $19.95 unlimited-use plan, changing the calculation behind spending another hour online.

events.title: The Prodigy releases Breathe
events.summary: Breathe extends the Prodigy’s route between electronic dance production and a forceful rock-facing performance style.

events.title: Snoop Doggy Dogg releases Tha Doggfather
events.summary: Tha Doggfather follows a debut that had helped make West Coast rap central to the early-decade conversation.

events.title: Space Jam joins the November lineup
events.summary: Basketball and cartoons share a place on the cinema screen.

events.title: Tamagotchi makes care portable
events.summary: Bandai’s original handheld care toy arrives.

events.title: The Smashing Pumpkins releases The Aeroplane Flies High
events.summary: A box set gathers the singles and associated recordings from the Mellon Collie period into another object to collect.

events.title: Scream opens before the holidays
events.summary: A December release for the horror film that knows its genre.

events.title: Diablo opens the cathedral door
events.summary: Diablo turns a descent beneath Tristram into a loop of exploration, combat and another piece of loot.

events.title: Daft Punk releases Homework in Europe
events.summary: A Paris home studio sends its dance tracks out into the world.

events.title: Final Fantasy VII arrives on PlayStation
events.summary: Cloud’s journey starts on Japanese shelves.

events.title: Deep Blue wins its match with Kasparov
events.summary: IBM’s chess computer wins a six-game rematch.

events.title: The WNBA tips off
events.summary: The Liberty and Sparks play the league’s inaugural game.

events.title: Men in Black opens for July
events.summary: A summer opening for the alien-investigation comedy.

events.title: Hong Kong’s handover reaches midnight
events.summary: A televised ceremony marks the transfer of sovereignty to China.

events.title: Pathfinder reaches Mars
events.summary: NASA’s Mars Pathfinder lands on the Red Planet.

events.title: South Park debuts on Comedy Central
events.summary: Four children in a Colorado town join late-night cable television.

events.title: Gattaca reaches theaters in October
events.summary: A science-fiction release on the autumn calendar.

events.title: The Lion King opens on Broadway
events.summary: The animated-film world becomes a live theatrical experience.

events.title: Metallica releases ReLoad
events.summary: Metallica releases ReLoad. The artist’s official discography supplies the release date.

events.title: StarCraft puts the battlefield on the desktop
events.summary: StarCraft becomes one of the decade’s enduring meeting points between a PC strategy game and competitive play.

events.title: The Good Friday Agreement is signed
events.summary: An agreement sets out a new political settlement for Northern Ireland.

events.title: The Truman Show opens in June
events.summary: A film about a television life joins the summer cinema schedule.

events.title: Windows 98 reaches the desktop
events.summary: A new Windows release arrives in the browser-heavy household PC era.

events.title: France wins its home World Cup
events.summary: The hosts beat Brazil at the Stade de France.

events.title: Saving Private Ryan opens in July
events.summary: The war drama arrives midway through the summer movie season.

events.title: The original iMac arrives
events.summary: The translucent all-in-one becomes a new kind of desktop object.

events.title: Lauryn Hill releases The Miseducation
events.summary: Her solo debut puts singing and rapping in the same conversation.

events.title: Google becomes a company
events.summary: A search project gets an incorporation date.

events.title: Game Boy Color arrives in Japan
events.summary: The handheld’s screen and shell both get a new look.

events.title: Ocarina of Time brings Hyrule into 3D
events.summary: Link’s Nintendo 64 adventure begins in Japan.

events.title: Metallica releases Garage Inc.
events.summary: Metallica releases Garage Inc.. The artist’s official discography supplies the release date.

events.title: The euro begins without notes or coins
events.summary: Eleven countries enter monetary union; physical euro cash comes later.

events.title: The Sopranos starts on HBO
events.summary: A New Jersey mob boss brings his problems into a therapist’s office.

events.title: Britney Spears releases her debut album
events.summary: …Baby One More Time moves from a hit single into an album.

events.title: Super Smash Bros. puts Nintendo’s cast together
events.summary: Mario and Link can finally settle an argument on the same screen.

events.title: The Matrix opens at the end of March
events.summary: A spring cinema date for the story behind the red-pill choice.

events.title: The USA wins the Women’s World Cup
events.summary: Brandi Chastain’s penalty ends a tense final against China.

events.title: The Blair Witch Project reaches theaters
events.summary: The July opening brings the woods into the summer cinema schedule.

events.title: Dreamcast’s 9/9/99 U.S. launch
events.summary: SEGA’s new console arrives in the United States.

events.title: Pokémon Gold and Silver open a new journey
events.summary: The Game Boy series returns with two new Japanese editions.

events.title: Metallica releases S&M
events.summary: Metallica releases S&M. The artist’s official discography supplies the release date.

events.title: Response teams watch the Y2K rollover
events.summary: The calendar change is a working night for people watching computer systems.
